en.metaDescription: Health insurance in Thailand for expats: hospitalisation, visa, quotes in French. Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Phuket, Pattaya, Hua Hin, Koh Samui. Tammy (AXA).
en.intro:
People search for health insurance in Thailand after a hospital bill or an admission guarantee request. Tammy compares KrungThai AXA plans (inpatient, outpatient, visa limits): on site in Surin; in Phuket, remotely or with a collaborator; in Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Pattaya, Hua Hin, Koh Samui, by phone and video.

Phuket page: Phuket Thailand health insurance · KrungThai AXA · Insurance quote / WhatsApp.

faq.question: Worth it if I’m healthy?
faq.answer: Care is excellent here; bills aren’t. Hospital + outpatient cover beats guessing after a scooter crash.

faq.question: Does my visa need a minimum policy?
faq.answer: Often yes (retirement, work, marriage visas…). We check the required limits before you sign.

faq.answer: AXA’s local health range in Thailand, several annual limits, sometimes an excess, partner hospitals. Picking a tier depends on your visa and monthly budget.

en.metaDescription: Real estate agency in Phuket and Krabi: house, villa, land and apartment for sale or rent. Thomas, French-speaking agent (Rawai, Chalong, Ao Nang).
en.intro: Real estate agency in Phuket and Krabi: Thomas helps with a house for sale in Phuket, house for sale in Krabi, villa, apartment, condo or land for sale, buy or long-term rent (Rawai, Chalong, Kata, Ao Nang).

faq.question: Can foreigners buy a house for sale in Phuket?
faq.answer: Condos often yes (foreign quota). Houses and villas are usually leasehold or local structures. Thomas explains what is realistic before viewings.

faq.question: Land for sale in Phuket or Krabi: is it possible?
faq.answer: Yes, with strict rules for foreigners. Thomas covers leasehold, build options and budget without empty promises.

faq.question: Best areas for property in Phuket?
faq.answer: Rawai, Nai Harn and Chalong for quiet life; Kata and Patong busier. In Krabi: Ao Nang and Krabi town.

faq.question: Long-term rental or apartment for rent in Phuket?
faq.answer: Thomas handles leases, handovers and renewals in Phuket and Krabi, useful before you buy.

faq.question: Villa for sale in Phuket or Krabi: where to start?
faq.answer: Use the contact form: budget, area, buy or rent. Thomas arranges viewings and negotiation in French.
